name: RC-B10-0247/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation of women and girls in Afghanistan following the Taliban’s adoption of the Criminal Procedure Code for Courts
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the Taliban to cancel a new set of court rules from January 2026 that it says harden discrimination against women and girls and allow torture, executions and slavery. It asks the European Union to sanction Taliban leaders, support international investigations, stop plans to invite Taliban representatives to Brussels, and let Afghans at risk stay in Europe. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- Nothing changes yet: the Parliament is stating demands, not passing binding rules.
- It targets Taliban leaders, European Union governments and Afghans seeking protection.
- Next, European Union institutions and member states decide whether to act on these calls.
